role: engineering fixed-funnel apparatus verification, not paper reproduction or parameter fitting

engineering_geometry.funnel: smooth truncated cone; LAMMPS native wall/gran/region, both caps open
engineering_geometry.gate: temporary horizontal contact plane, removed after loading stability check
engineering_geometry.base: infinite smooth plane; geometric proxy for aluminium, interface not calibrated
engineering_geometry.capacity_note: geometrical volume only, not measured packing capacity

unverified: Paper funnel dimensions, outlet height, gate/loading method and feed rate
Equivalence of EDEM Type-C and LAMMPS SDS rolling laws
Effect of persistent sphere spin without a twisting resistance model

engineering_contact_baseline.wall_basis: engineering starting values copied from particle baseline, not measured aluminium

measurement.mass: N * rho * pi * d^3 / 6, rounded particle count
measurement.gate_release: after all particles inserted, >=0.24 s dwell, and three consecutive translation KE/(Mgd)<1e-5 samples
measurement.geometry_stop: all particles below outlet with three consecutive translation KE/(Mgd)<1e-5 samples
measurement.angle: eight 45-degree radial sectors, least-squares upper outline slope; spatial SD is not repeated-trial SD
